 Liga MX Chivas Guadalajara vs Atlante live online: score, stats, goals & updates | Liga MX Apertura 2026
 Live Liga MX commentary from Estadio Akron, as Chivas and Atlante meet on matchday 15 of the Apertura 2026 regular season today, Saturday, October 31.
 AS USA Update: Oct 31st, 2026 20:37 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google With top spot still in reach, Chivas Guadalajara will bid to extend its four-game unbeaten streak in the Apertura 2026 regular season, when Gabriel Milito’s men host Atlante at Estadio Akron on Saturday.
 Guadalajara heads into matchday 15 on the back of two wins and two draws . Most recently, the fourth-placed Los Rojiblancos claimed a 1-0 triumph at Monterrey.
 Meanwhile, Atlante sits outside of the Apertura playoff picture , with matchday 14’s 1-0 defeat to Atlético San Luis leaving Los Potros de Hierro down in 16th.
